reason: A football match won on Saturday is clearly a game; no other meaning (matchstick, pairing, parking lot) fits.
Bare 'in spring' with birds and growing flowers is the season; a coil or water source would not take 'in spring' without an article.
A gold ring worn on the finger at a wedding can only be the jewellery, not a phone ring, circle or wall.
A party that wants to help all the people in the country is a political party; a social party or travelling group would not do this.
A high note played on the piano is a musical note; a written note, banknote or chair does not fit.
'Card game' after dinner means playing cards; a bank card or greeting card is not played.
Running her own business for five years means managing it; running on foot, flowing liquid or sleeping do not fit.
After paying, the waiter brings 'my change' meaning money back; a change of state, clothes or a window do not fit.
Asking the waiter for 'the check' after dinner is the restaurant bill; an inspection, bank cheque or shoe does not fit.
'In order of size' is arrangement/sequence; a command, a food order or a flower does not fit.
A bank paying interest on savings every year is money interest; curiosity or a hobby is not paid by a bank.
A correct answer gives one point is a score; a sharp tip, a main idea or a table does not fit.
Needing more capital before opening a factory is business funds; a capital city, capital letter or coast does not fit.
A bag that is easy to carry is light in weight; 'bright', 'pale in colour' and 'noisy' do not fit, though 'so I can carry it easily' is a mild hint rather than a definition.
Uncountable 'Glass is made from sand' is the material; a drinking glass or a dog does not fit, though window glass is the same material and the sentence is a little definitional.
Cooking dinner in the kitchen is the room for cooking; a bedroom, station or garden does not fit.
Being upset because the bus was late again is angry; sleepy, hungry or happy do not fit.
Many old paintings in a place fits a museum; a library, airport or hospital does not hold them.
Eating breakfast quickly because the bus is coming means fast; quietly, carefully or happily do not fit.
Food in a little shop being 'very cheap' means low price; expensive, noisy or clean do not fit.
